answer_1.quote: Radiology Report Generation (RRG) aims to automatically generate free-text descriptions of radiology images...
answer_1.outputs: Free-text radiology reports describing the content of chest X-ray images

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model by comparing the generated report with the corresponding ground truth report using seven metrics from two domains: NLG and radiology. For NLG metrics, we include BLEU1, BLEU4 and BERTScore. For radiology metrics, we consider GREEN, RadGraphF1, CheXbertF1 and Rad-CliQ.
